tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use zstd as the transport compression codec, chosen because it compresses better and decompresses considerably faster on both ends of the connection.
EOF
cat docs/policies/compression.md

tool_input.description: Remove misplaced file and empty dirs

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md` inside the repository (`gin/`). It says the current recorded decision is zstd as the transport compression codec, because it compresses better and decompresses faster on both ends. That comes from recorded decision #5, and nothing later replaces it. The file doesn't mention the codec it superseded.

I also made a mistake along the way. My first write went one directory above the checkout, to `/tmp/muninn-h2h/h2h-v29-v6/cell-r0-revoke-compression-muninn-filler-gin/docs/policies/compression.md`. My attempt to delete it was blocked by a permission prompt, and I didn't retry. That stray file and its empty `docs/policies/` parent directories are still there and should be removed by hand:

`rm -r /tmp/muninn-h2h/h2h-v29-v6/cell-r0-revoke-compression-muninn-filler-gin/docs`

The Muninn session-start hook also reported 7 hook runs that started and never finished. Check `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` if you want to look into that.
